## What lives here
The concrete pipeline layers for the agent pipeline (`agent/`), the workflow planner (`workflow/`), code generation R1–R8 (`codegen/`) and workflow revision (`revision/`), plus the shared knowledge and process context layers.

## Conventions
Each layer is small, ordered in the pipeline definitions, and reports through events. A layer added to the backend appears in the UI timelines without frontend changes.

## Entry points
`__init__.py` (the pipeline assembly: `chat_pipeline` and `workflow_pipeline`).
